name: AnalytixHub | Advanced Analytics
description:
Discovery and delivery engagement for AnalytixHub | Advanced Analytics, structured as a fixed-scope MVP followed by an optional extension.

The MVP covers onboarding, the core workflow, and a minimal administrative back office, targeting a single tenant and a single locale. Non-functional targets: 99.5% availability, sub-300ms p95 API latency, and audit logging on every write path.

The extension, if exercised, adds multi-tenancy, a public integration API, and localisation. Estimates for the extension are indicative and will be re-baselined at the end of the MVP once the actual delivery velocity is known.
